data.narrative:
BurnBot is a Series A climate & energy company founded by Anukool Lakhina and Waleed 'Lee' Haddad that has raised $25M to date. The valuation universe includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers in the Climate & Energy sector, including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation tiers to support a reliable peer-median methodology.

The analysis relies on stage-progression analysis, which applies a 2.0x multiplier to the $25M total raised proxy—a standard step-up assumption for Series A to subsequent-stage advancement. This method yields an implied valuation of $50M. A peer-median approach was not applicable given the absence of three or more narrowly-filtered comparables at the same stage or valuation tier within the Climate & Energy sector.

The triangulated valuation range is $42M to $57M, with a median of $50M. This range is supported by a single applicable method and should be interpreted as indicative rather than definitive. Key uncertainties include the degree to which stage-progression multipliers hold for frontier-tech subsectors within climate & energy, and the absence of transaction or revenue data to anchor capital-efficiency or margin assumptions. Additional data on peer fundraising trajectories, burn rates, or technical milestones would strengthen conviction in this range.
